<function name="IsSubscribed" parent="steamworks" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns whenever the client is subscribed to the specified Steam Workshop item.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="workshopItemID" type="string">The ID of the Steam Workshop item.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is the client subscribed to the addon or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Checks if client is subscribed to Gm_construct_Beta Steam Workshop addon.</description>
	<code>print( steamworks.IsSubscribed( 21197 ) )</code>
	<output>If client is subscribed true is printed into console, false otherwise.</output>

</example>
